semiconductor_relevance: High — Leadchem specializes in high-purity precursor canisters essential for the safe handling of materials in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Jiangsu Leadchem Semiconductor Technology manufactures high-purity precursor canisters tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their products ensure compliance with stringent purity standards, facilitating the efficient handling of both solid and liquid precursors. The company also showcases a pilot plant model to demonstrate the practical application of their technology.
